visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs walks down stone stairs wearing a white kimono with a dark sash. She opens a large white traditional umbrella against a background of green and yellow autumn trees. (2) She smiles widely at the camera, then transitions to wearing a navy blue school uniform with a white knit hat, riding a blue bicycle while eating a piece of white bread. (3) She appears in a park setting with vibrant orange and red autumn leaves, wearing a floral vest over a white blouse and a red skirt. She is seen sliding down a yellow slide and swinging on a swing, laughing and displaying high energy. (4) The woman is framed by bright red maple leaves, posing with her hands making a frame shape. She then walks along a suburban road lined with yellow ginkgo trees, wearing a blue and white dress with a white headband. (5) In front of a scenic view of Mount Fuji, she wears a white sweater and holds a soft-serve ice cream cone. A montage follows showing her with white furry ears, and another of her eating a snack indoors. (6) She is seen in a bathtub with beige tiled walls and a cartoon fish decoration, wearing a white lace slip and splashing water playfully towards the lens. (7) Indoors in a traditional Japanese room, she toasts with a glass of tea while wearing a red Rakuten Monkeys baseball jersey. She then appears in a white jacket playing kendama, and finally holding an orange gift bag in a forest setting. (8) The video concludes with a black screen featuring white stylized text.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Traditional Japanese stone stairs, autumn parks with maple and ginkgo trees, Mount Fuji in the distance, a suburban street, a tiled bathroom, and a traditional Japanese interior with tatami-style sliding doors.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic dance music starts immediately with a strong 4/4 beat and bright synth chords. A sharp percussion 'hit' occurs within the first second. (2) A synthesized transition effect 'whoosh' follows. A female voice shouts an energetic Japanese greeting, high in pitch and arousal. (3) The rhythmic loop continues with heavy bass and percussive transients matching visual transitions. (4) Another vocal shout, sounding like 'Kawaii', is delivered with a rising intonation and very positive valence. (5) Fast-paced editing is accompanied by repetitive digital SFX 'beeps' or 'clicks' that sync with the visual montage changes. (6) The music maintains a constant high-tempo energy until the final second, ending with a sharp digital stinger cut.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of Aesthetic Showcases -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and showcase the 2026 autumn-themed calendar for 'Lanlan' (籃籃), utilizing a fast-paced aesthetic montage that highlights her charm, various Japanese-themed locations, and diverse outfits to drive pre-orders.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: On-screen text explicitly mentions '籃籃 秋之年曆 2026' and '預購中!' (Pre-order now).
